[NDBG.12.5.4] Response follows the same shape as
`ds/setFactBreakpoints` — one entry per breakpoint with `id` and
`verified`. A key is a string, not an expression, so nothing is compiled. An
entry is `verified: false`, with a message saying why, in three cases: its
`key` is not a string; its `on` is not a non-empty list of `"get"`, `"set"`
and `"delete"`; or it is a `"get"` in replay ([NDBG.12.5.2]).
